title.native: 手札が多めのビクトリア

synonyms: วิกตอเรียผู้มีสารพัดไพ่ลับในมือ

name.native: ビクトリア・セラーズ

node.description:
A former operative skilled in a wide range of areas, including disguise, forgery, and combat techniques. 

Although she chose to leave the organization and live under the alias "Victoria," she struggles to fully break ties with her past and is awkward when it comes to pursuing her own happiness. However, through her encounters with Nonna and Jeffrey, she begins to carve out a new life for herself.

A young girl whom Victoria took in after she had been abandoned. 

Though she initially understood her situation and was quiet and well-behaved, she gradually becomes more emotionally expressive while living with Victoria. She deeply adores Victoria and has a profound impact on her, becoming a truly cherished presence in her life.

name.native: ジェフリー・アッシャー

node.description:
The commander of the Second Knight Order, responsible for guarding the capital of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a man of integrity who enjoys the deep trust of those around him. 

When Victoria took Nonna under her protection, he stepped forward to act as her guarantor. Although he had long avoided falling in love due to emotional scars from an incident ten years prior, he finds himself drawn to the refreshing charm of Victoria, who lives her life with independence and spirit.

The proprietor of "The Black Thrush," a tavern located in the backstreets of the royal capital. He takes a liking to the way Victoria quietly enjoys her drink when she visits the establishment. 

Seeming well-versed in the affairs of the underworld, he and Victoria sense that neither of them is an ordinary individual.

name.native: コンラッド・アシュベリー

node.description:
The Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a thoughtful and gentle-natured man who holds Geoffrey in high regard and is fond of him. 

Upon learning of Victoria—with whom Geoffrey is close—he seeks to give Geoffrey a push in the right direction.

name.native: クラーク・アンダーソン

node.description:
Jeffrey's nephew. 

He had lost confidence because he struggled with both foreign languages ​​and athletics, but after being tutored by Victoria, he discovered the joy of learning. He has a sensitive yet open nature and becomes close with Nonna, who attends lessons alongside him.

name.native: セドリック・アシュベリー

node.description:
The second prince of the Kingdom of Ashbury. 

In stark contrast to his older brother Conrad, he possesses a cheerful and energetic personality. His straightforward nature—free of pretense—has earned him the affection of his subordinates. 

Confident in his swordsmanship, he becomes intrigued after hearing rumors of Victoria's formidable skill.

The leader of the Haguru Kingdom's special operations unit. 

He took Victoria away from her impoverished family when she was young and raised her within the organization as the operative "Chloe." To Chloe, he was not only her superior but also a figure she looked up to like an older brother.

The widow of the late Earl of Haynes. 

She met Victoria following a purse-snatching incident and ended up renting the estate's annex to her, as Victoria was looking for a place to stay. She took a great liking to Victoria—who is cultured and an excellent cook—and became very fond of both her and Nonna.

name.native: エドワード・アッシャー

node.description:
Jeffrey’s older brother. 

Although he is the head of a count’s family, he serves as the de facto leader of the Ashbury Royal Castle’s Department for the Maintenance and Management of Systems—commonly known as the Third Knight Order. Devoted to his younger brother, he takes an interest in Victoria upon learning that Jeffrey—who had long kept his distance from women—has grown close to her.

name.native: バーナード・フィッチャー

node.description:
He is Jeffrey’s uncle and a renowned historian. 

Possessing a difficult temperament that caused previous assistants and servants to quit quickly, he hires Victoria as his new assistant and housemaid. He grows fond of Victoria—who is fluent in multiple languages ​​and adept at household chores like cleaning and cooking—and gradually becomes gentler in nature.
